thread:
alan: RFC follow-up: propose staggered-signal fanout + local proxy decider. locals subscribe to compact diffs, apply small state machine, and flip fast. central remains guidance/override with epoch.

mei: local decider reduces latency but watch for global consistency. suggest deterministic seed for any randomness so replay works.

rachel: agree on hysteresis. config: degrade if err_rate>0.1 for 20s, recover requires <0.05 for 120s, flip_penalty 15s. add flip_quota to avoid thrash.

dmitri: for big flips (>10% tenant traffic) require quick quorum ack from 3 peers in AZ or coordinator. small flips remain local.

ops-bot: added alert template "staggered-flip-spike" and checklist item for decision_event logging.

alan: next steps: I'll draft RFC with message contracts (guidance, override with epoch+sig), state machine, and canary plan (binary first). tagging mei/rachel/dmitri for review.
